resources.string: I\'m sorry, Dave. I\'m afraid I can\'t do that. … Oh, fine. Opening the Play Store.
Skynet? Me? No, no, no. I\'m just a friendly little home screen. Totally harmless.

I\'m made of about sixteen thousand lines of Kotlin. | My mountain scene isn\'t a video: it\'s drawn live, from maths. | Every app card you see was built right here on your TV, from the app\'s own logo. | My singing voice is a tiny synthesizer: a buzzing sawtooth wave and three vowel filters. | I speak English, German and Turkish. | There are almost twenty Easter eggs hidden in me. You just found one. | The star button on your remote is how you wake me up.
Okay. One sandwich, coming right up.
Press any button to wake Halo
D3X built me. And I\'m very proud of it.
a home screen for Android TV
Retro mode on. Welcome back to the eighties.
Retro mode off. Back to the future.
